## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify the affected module/member
and whether this changes a shared contract. Link the related issue if applicable.

## Verification

Record commands, actual results, and any manual IDE steps performed. State what
has not been verified; do not mark sample behavior as real RAG/LLM/F2 integration.

## Integration notes

Describe teammate dependencies, configuration changes or follow-up decisions.
If relevant, explain cancellation/disposal behavior, source citations, or how Diff
review, approval and stale-file validation protect the original file.
